From: Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@skylinehealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@skylinehealth.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / subservice carve-out info for Skyline — audit window Oct 1 2025 - Sep 30 2026

Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this. We're finalizing our vendor risk pack for Redwood ahead of our annual security board. A couple of asks so we can complete Skyline's SOC 2 dependency mapping and procurement sign-off: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering Redwood's production environment; if the report's audit period does not exactly match our window (Oct 1, 2025 - Sep 30, 2026), please include the official audit period covered and any statements about overlapping coverage or rolling reports.

2) A bridge letter or attestation that specifically addresses (a) subservice organizations you rely on (cloud providers, managed DBs, KMS providers), (b) which responsibilities are carved out to those providers vs Redwood, and (c) whether anything materially changed in the period between the SOC report end date and Sep 30, 2026. We need this so our auditors can rely on the mapping to AWS/GCP SOC docs where appropriate.

3) A current subprocessor inventory (CSV or spreadsheet) with the role, region, last-processed date, and contract effective date. Skyline's infosec requires a line for any third party that can access customer data or customer-managed KMS keys.

4) For KMS/custody: sample evidence or a short narrative on key custody and snapshot retention (where snapshots are stored and which subprocessors have access).

5) If you have a standard bridge letter template, please send a draft we can review. Also let us know if you can sign a short attestation confirming no material changes since the report's cutoff.

Target timeline: our audit window is tight — can you confirm by Oct 2 whether you can provide the SOC 2 PDF + draft bridge letter + subprocessor inventory? If you need a short call to align scope, we're available Mon/Tue next week.

Appreciate it — downtime on this will delay procurement sign-off.

Best,
Taylor Brooks
Security & Risk Manager
Skyline Health
Attachments: request_requirements_list.pdf, Skyline_Risk_Form.docx
